_doc: Experiment queue read by scripts/scheduler.py. Entries run in order on the first idle machine of their class. Each entry ties to a hypothesis in docs/RESEARCH_LOG.md. status: queued | running | done | failed | blocked. Shell snippets run on the target host in ~/pi unless noted; {HOST} is the target address, {RUN} the run name, {LATEST:<dir>} the highest step_* directory under <dir> on the target.

h100.name: pi05_curriculum2
h100.hypothesis: H1b: easy rungs first learns fastest; stage 2 adds handover and two_bins plus recover2 data
h100.setup: mkdir -p data/sim_mixrec2_v1 && cd data/sim_mixrec2_v1 && for d in ../sim_mix_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d $(basename $d); done && for d in ../sim_recover2_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d episode_rec2_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done
h100.train: RESUME={LATEST:runs/pi05_easy} META=data/sim_mix_v1/pi07_meta GPUS=0 bash scripts/box/train_pi05.sh data/sim_mixrec2_v1 runs/{RUN} 10000
h100.eval: GPU=0 NAME={RUN} EPISODES=16 TASKS='pick_place_any bin handover two_bins' MUJOCO_GL=egl bash scripts/box/eval_when_ready.sh runs/{RUN} 1000 2000 3000 4000 5000 6000 7000 8000 9000 10000

h100.name: pi05_lr5e5
h100.hypothesis: H5: the two-arm mix is under-trained at 2.5e-5; 5e-5 learns faster without destabilising
h100.setup: mkdir -p data/sim_mixrec2_v1 && cd data/sim_mixrec2_v1 && for d in ../sim_mix_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d $(basename $d); done && for d in ../sim_recover2_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d episode_rec2_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done
h100.train: LR=5e-5 META=data/sim_mix_v1/pi07_meta GPUS=0 bash scripts/box/train_pi05.sh data/sim_mixrec2_v1 runs/{RUN} 12000
h100.eval: GPU=0 NAME={RUN} EPISODES=16 TASKS='pick_place_any bin handover two_bins' MUJOCO_GL=egl bash scripts/box/eval_when_ready.sh runs/{RUN} 1000 2000 3000 4000 5000 6000 7000 8000 9000 10000 11000 12000

h100.name: pi05_dagger1
h100.hypothesis: H2b: DAgger — teacher continuations from the states the policy actually reaches fix compounding errors; fine-tune pi05_v1 on mix + recover2 + DAgger data
h100.blocked_on: data/sim_dagger_v1 being generated on the first A10 (queue entry dagger1_generate); set to queued when done
h100.prep_on_main: ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_evalbox -o BatchMode=yes ubuntu@129.213.124.160 'tar cf - -C ~/pi/data sim_dagger_v1' | tar xf - -C data && rsync -a -e 'ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_evalbox -o BatchMode=yes' data/sim_recover2_v1 data/sim_dagger_v1 ubuntu@{HOST}:~/pi/data/ 2>/dev/null; true
h100.setup: mkdir -p data/sim_mixdag_v1 && cd data/sim_mixdag_v1 && for d in ../sim_mix_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d $(basename $d); done && for d in ../sim_recover2_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d episode_rec2_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done && for d in ../sim_dagger_v1/episode_*; do ln -sfn $d episode_dag_$(basename $d | cut -d_ -f2); done
h100.train: RESUME={LATEST:runs/pi05_v1} META=data/sim_mix_v1/pi07_meta GPUS=0 bash scripts/box/train_pi05.sh data/sim_mixdag_v1 runs/{RUN} 8000
h100.eval: GPU=0 NAME={RUN} EPISODES=16 TASKS='pick_place_any bin handover two_bins' MUJOCO_GL=egl bash scripts/box/eval_when_ready.sh runs/{RUN} 1000 2000 3000 4000 5000 6000 7000 8000

a10.name: single6000_execute_sweep
a10.hypothesis: H6: re-planning more often (execute 10 or 15 actions per chunk) raises closed-loop success of the solved single-arm model
a10.eval: for E in 10 15 40; do MUJOCO_GL=egl ~/lerobot-venv/bin/python -m pi_model.eval_sim --checkpoint exports/pi05_single/step_0006000 --episodes 30 --episode-seconds 20 --execute $E --delay 0 --device cuda --subtask oracle --seed 1000 --out outputs/eval_single6000exec${E}_step6000_pick_place; done

a10.name: dagger1_generate
a10.hypothesis: H2b data: policy rollout (pi05_v1 step 8000) then teacher takeover, 150 episodes per rung
